description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification No. 991 - Order made to amend the Sec. 26, 27 and 39 of Excise Notification No. 844 published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No.1232/12 of 18.04.2002 w.e.f. 01.01.2017
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves amendments to excise regulations and rules governing distilleries/warehouses. It contains legal/regulatory modifications to the Excise Ordinance through a formal notification, including specific changes to sections 26, 27, and 39. While it mentions Ravi Karunanayake as Minister of Finance, this is only in the context of exercising statutory powers under the ordinance, not detailing his portfolio responsibilities or making personnel changes. The core content is regulatory in nature, focusing on compliance requirements, duty payment rules, and administrative procedures for excise operations.
